title: GPT-6.1 Sol launch · Low effort
methodologySummary: Launch chart results at Low reasoning effort. GPT evaluations ran in OpenAI research environments or its API. Competitor scores were taken from public reports. Exact chart values, versions, subsets and documented fallbacks are preserved.
limitations: One publisher does not prove matching harnesses, tools or deployments. Numeric highlighting does not establish matching evaluation setups.
AutomationBench 1.0.6 stays separate from the unversioned Google result; identical task subsets are not established.
OSWorld reports partial reward on the offline v2026.08.08 release, separate from other OSWorld versions and subsets.
Factuality uses difficult, previously flagged conversations and does not measure error rates in typical usage.
The Fable AutomationBench point uses Opus 5 fallbacks on about 40% of tasks; reported costs omit fallbacks. Costs are not imported into StackReplay pricing.
